{{Quote|...the Allusis was being upgraded at the Fondor shipyards when the Mandalorians attacked. That ship was supposed to be the vanguard of the fleet--if a renegade clan is using it as a base of operations, we need to get it back.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />}}
The '''''Allusis''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[B5-2T]] was stationed on the ship.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

The ship was named in memory of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Belth Allusis]],<ref name="TOR:IFMR" /> who died while leading the final stand to defend the [[Bothawui planetary shield]] at the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|Second Battle of Bothawui]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Duarl'']]</ref>

The ''Allusis'' was the setting for a battle between Republic, [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]], and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces after [[Clan Varad]] hijacked the ship out of the Republic [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />
